pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/lib/utils/sanitizers/__tests__/hostileToolOutput.golden.test.ts:15 The only eval-flavoured file here ('GOLDEN EVAL') runs recorded attack fixtures through the deterministic function maskSensitiveJson and says that the model is out of scope, so no non-deterministic system is scored and the subject's precondition does not hold (the deterministic suite falls under test-harness); a case-insensitive grep of src/lib/utils for judge, rubric, trials, holdout and pairwise found no hits.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/utils/sanitizers/__tests__/hostileToolOutput.golden.test.ts:94 Pure deterministic assertions on a non-model function; no judge is possible or needed, and no model output is scored.

pairs.registryProposal: A fixture-driven deterministic test that calls itself a 'golden eval' sits on the boundary with test-harness. The golden path could say plainly that the subject begins only when the thing being scored is non-deterministic, so a self-label does not pull a deterministic suite in.
